## The decision it would improve

What question about a site would this answer that the tool cannot answer today? Who is asking it, and what would they do differently with the answer?

## Proposal

Describe the capability. If it is a crop, a strategy or a data source, [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) lists what each one needs.

## Evidence it would rest on

Every number this tool shows carries its basis. Name the source for any value this feature would introduce: a measurement, a published figure, a manufacturer document, or an explicitly labeled assumption. A capability that can only be built on unsourced numbers is a capability this project will decline.

## Claim it would allow, and claims it would not

State the strongest honest sentence a user could say after this feature exists, and the sentence they still could not say. The evidence ladder is in [docs/EVALUATION.md](../../docs/EVALUATION.md) and the roadmap gates are in [docs/DIGITAL-TWIN.md](../../docs/DIGITAL-TWIN.md).

## Constraints to respect

- [ ] No runtime dependency, no build step, no backend
- [ ] Works from a static host, offline once the data is imported
- [ ] Does not imply a manufacturer performance comparison
- [ ] Does not raise the evidence tier without the evidence to match
